text: 1. The first page of a valid ordinary passport (the validity of the passport should be later than December 1, 2025), and a valid visa page or residence permit page (required for students in China).2. Four one-inch, bareheaded, white-background color photos taken within the last six months.3. Bachelor's degree or above or a pre-graduation certificate.Applicants who graduated from institutions within China must submit the Electronic registration and Verification Report of Academic Certificates of the Ministry of Education and the Online Verification Report of Higher Education Degrees of the Ministry of Education (https://www.chsi.com.cn).Applicants who graduated from overseas institutions must submit the "Certificate of Overseas Education and Degree" on the website of the China Academic Degrees and Graduate Education Development Center (https://www.cscse.edu.cn).Fresh graduates can first submit a pre-graduation certificate issued by their current school. Those who fail to submit their bachelor's degree certificates before enrollment will have their admission qualifications revoked.4. Complete transcript of the undergraduate stage. The transcript should be issued and stamped by the academic affairs department or relevant student management department of the school attended. Fresh graduates can first submit the current transcript issued by their school. Those who fail to submit the complete transcript of their undergraduate stage before enrollment will have their admission qualifications revoked.5. HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) Level 5 or 6 certificate (valid for 2 years).6. Two academic recommendation letters. Two recommendation letters from professors, associate professors or experts with equivalent technical titles in the applied professional field must be submitted, written in either Chinese or English (including the recommenders' handwritten signatures and valid contact information).7. Study and Research Plan in China. The text should be written in either Chinese or English. The main content should be over 1,000 words, including but not limited to personal study and work experience, academic research achievements, research plans during the master's stage, and personal development plans after graduation.8. Portfolio. A portfolio related to the applied major, with a brief introduction to each work (including the work name, size, creation time, creation description, etc.); Or the list and abstracts of published academic articles; Or other original academic achievements.9. Proof of economic status and guarantor of affairs in China.Submit a deposit balance certificate issued by the bank, with an amount of approximately 100,000 RMB or more. If the bank account is not held by the applicant himself/herself, proof of family relationship with the economic guarantor must be submitted simultaneously, such as: birth certificate, household register, notarized documents, etc.Submit the guarantor of the affairs in China along with a copy of the guarantor's identity document.10. Copy of the "Physical Examination Form for Foreigners". The examination results must be stamped with the official seal of the hospital and are valid for six months.11. "Admission Application Form for International Students of Guangzhou Academy of Fine Arts" and Commitment Letter.12. Other supporting materials that may be required to be submitted.
